description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogAPI class, which implements RESTful API endpoints for managing performance tracker logs within an HR management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance tracker logs, along with associated validation rules and annotations for API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger. The class utilizes various traits and dependencies to handle authorization, data access, and business logic related to performance tracker logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for performance tracker logs, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting logs within a performance management module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a list of performance tracker logs with filtering, sorting, and pagination support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new performance tracker log, associating it with a specific tracker, user, and reviewer.

methods.name: setTrackerLogsParams
methods.description: Sets log-related parameters into a PerformanceTrackerLog entity based on request data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Provides validation rules for common request body parameters when creating or updating logs.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more logs associated with a specific tracker, after verifying access permissions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch details of a single performance tracker log by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing performance tracker log identified by ID.
